ppl_texts: Language models are neural networks trained to predict text. Quantization reduces the memory needed to store their weights, but aggressive quantization can damage the model's internal representations.
A useful compression method must preserve quality, reduce memory, and keep inference fast enough for practical deployment.
Mixed precision quantization assigns more bits to sensitive layers and fewer bits to layers that tolerate stronger compression.
